reviewed_runtime_surfaces.reason: Dynamic module discovery/import/execution; model-assisted risk scoring is not a sandbox; local key/config and state integration.
Historical aiohttp server binds 0.0.0.0:1138 and exposes state/device-command write routes without a visible authentication layer in the reviewed source.
Launches an external Windows executable, opens COM3, writes adaptive serial commands and operational files.
Opens COM3, reads local runtime state, changes gain parameters and sends SET commands; TachyonField is ordinary finite-difference extrapolation, not tachyon physics.
Long/infinite local optimization loops can consume CPU/GPU resources and grow local histories.
Initializes OpenCL GPU execution and mutates linked environment state after repeated failures.

critical_boundaries: A model-generated risk score is a heuristic, not a sandbox, capability boundary, code-signing mechanism or security review.
Dynamic Python import executes code with the permissions of the current process.
A historical network server is not safe for LAN/public exposure merely because it is archived.
Historical serial-control code can create real device side effects even when its variable names are metaphorical.

targeted_public_tree_marker_scan.generic_AAIza_prefix_note: A generic AIza code-search hit was inspected and was a prefix check for locally ingested keys, not an embedded key value.
targeted_public_tree_marker_scan.scope_boundary: This targeted marker scan is not a complete secret-scanning proof and does not establish that Git history or every file is credential-free.

historical_archive_boundary.policy: Any credential known to have appeared in historical archives or Git history should be treated as potentially compromised and replaced before reuse.

safe_review_default: use disposable non-privileged isolation for execution
provide no production credentials or private mounts
disable outbound networking unless explicitly required and controlled
review dynamic imports, subprocess/system calls, filesystem writes, deserialization and network paths before execution
interpretation: Preserving historical executable source is useful for provenance and software archaeology. Registry presence is not a recommendation to run it.
